Title: Garrosh Patch
Subtitle: New Hero: Garrosh
Affected: Hanamura (Removed for rework) Ranked Battleground rotations: + Battlefield of Eternity + Blackheart's Bay + Braxis Holdout + Sky Temple - Hanamura - Haunted Mines - Infernal Shrines - Tomb of the Spider Queen
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Deadly Charge to go on a full cooldown if Alarak is hit by Phase Prism while channeling.
  • Marking The Lost Vikings with Rite of Rak'Shir during their Longboat Raid Ability and then killing the Longboat will now correctly grant bonus Sadism and Rite of Rak'shir cooldown reduction.

=== Heroes: Artanis ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Deadly Charge to go on a full cooldown if Alarak is hit by Phase Prism while channeling.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • After Arthas completing the Frost Presence Questing Talent the Shattered Armor Talent will now correctly apply Armor Reduction to Heroes who have been rooted by Howling Blast.

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[Updates]
  • Auriel's resource bar will now glow when at maximum Hope.

=== Heroes: Cassia ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Blinding Light will no longer reveal Stealthed enemy Heroes.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Medivh's Ley Line Seal can no longer cause Chen and his Storm, Earth, Fire Spirits to exist simultaneously.

=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Diverting Power (W)
      • Instead of preventing D.Va from moving during Defense Matrix, this talent now adds an additional 50% slow.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Now properly contests Objective Capture Points while exiting her Mech.
  • Now properly contests and pushes Hanamura Payloads while exiting her Mech.
  • D.Va's Basic Attacks are now halted during her Taunt and Dance animations.
  • The Call Mech status bar that appears under D.Va's party frame portrait no longer persists after she dies and respawns in Mech Mode.

=== Heroes: Garrosh ===
[Releases]
  Garrosh, Son of Hellscream, has been added to the Nexus and is now available for play! Read on for a brief overview of his Abilities.:
  Trait:
  • Armor Up
    • Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing.
  Basic Abilities:
  • Groundbreaker (Q)
    • Deal damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are pulled toward Garrosh.
  • Bloodthirst (W)
    • Deal damage to an enemy and Heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.
  • Wrecking Ball (E)
    • Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing damage enemies near the impact and slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Warlord's Challenge (R)
    • Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 1.5 seconds.
  • Decimate (R)
    • Deal damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.
    • Stores up to 3 charges.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • X-Strike can now be properly self-cast.
  • Fixed an issue preventing the Shingan talent from playing quest tracking sounds if a target was hit with all 3 Shurikens.

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now correctly cast Go For the Throat a second time after using the Ability to kill D.Va's Mech.

=== Heroes: Kharazim ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Seven-Sided Strike will no longer target D.Va's Mech during Self-Destruct.

=== Heroes: Lt. Morales ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Entering a Medivac as it is destroyed will no longer cause the Medivac UI to persist on-screen.

=== Heroes: Probius ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Worker Rush (Z)
    • Worker Rush can no longer be activated while the Worker Rush buff is still active. This will prevent players from accidentally placing the ability on cooldown when leaving the Hall of Storms.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Pylons that are affected by a time stop, such as Zeratul's Void Prison, will no longer cause Warp Rift's cooldown to be paused for the duration of the effect.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Living Meteor (W)
    • Damage reduced from 72 to 68
  • Blast Wave (E)
    • Cooldown reduced from 10 to 9 seconds
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Shifting Meteor (W)
      • Additional Functionality:
        • Each time an enemy is hit by Living Meteor, they take an additional 3% damage from subsequent hits by the same Meteor
    • Engulfing Flame (E)
      • Adjusted functionality:
        • No longer grants cooldown reduction on Blast Wave
        • Now also increases the damage of Blast Wave by 75%
  • Level 7
    • Superheated (E)
      • Removed
    • New Talent: Blistering Attacks (Passive)
      • Every 10 seconds, your next Basic Attack deals 60% bonus damage. Enemies hit by your Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second
    • Molten Power (W)
      • Damage bonus increased from 15 to 20% per enemy Hero hit
  • Level 20
    • Lava Surge (R)
      • Cooldown reduction increased from 10 to 30 seconds
[Bug Fixes]
  • Lava Wave now correctly contributes to Ragnaros's Siege Damage.

=== Heroes: Rexxar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Misha to become briefly unresponsive after respawning if she was killed while Rexxar was affected by time stop effect.

=== Heroes: Samuro ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Selecting Mirror Images via control groups will no longer cancel their active movement commands.

=== Heroes: Sonya ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Whirlwind (E)
    • The time required after activation before the ability can be canceled has been increased from .5 to 1 seconds. This should help prevent accidental cancellations.
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Ancient Spear model will no longer visually persist when cast on an allied Gate prior to game start.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can no longer cast Possession on units spawned by Bosses on Warhead Junction.

=== Heroes: The Butcher ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • Basic Attack damage lowered from 140 to 130
  Abilities:
  • Fresh Meat (Trait)
    • Meat required to complete his quest increased from 125 to 200
    • Damage bonus per Meat stack decreased from 1 to .5
    • Meat dropped by enemy Heroes increased from 5 to 25
    • Bonus damage on quest completion increased from 100 to 125
    • Once the quest is completed, enemy Heroes continue to drop Meat, giving The Butcher 5 permanent Basic Attack damage per Meat collected
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Abattoir (Trait)
      • Removed
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that allowed Sanctification to go off despite Tyrael being stunned by Ruthless Onslaught.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue allowing Sundering to be seen and heard through fog of war.

=== Heroes: Tracer ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Ricochet will no longer cause Tracer's Basic Attacks to bounce to Stealthed Heroes.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue preventing Drakken Laser Drill from displaying a range indicator.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that allowed Sanctification to go off despite Tyrael being stunned by Ruthless Onslaught.

=== Heroes: Valeera ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Valeera to break Stealth if Sinister Strike was cast immediately before attempting to Vanish.

=== Heroes: Valla ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that prevented the Death Dealer talent from refreshing the cooldown of Vault after killing a structure.

=== Heroes: Zul'jin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue preventing Zul'jin from self-casting Guillotine.
